cards.front: Que lo haga Pepe. Es suficientemente viejo y feo para hacerlo él mismo.
cards.back: Let Pepe do it. He's old and ugly enough to do it by himself.

cards.front: Que haga lo que quiera. Él es el que manda.
cards.back: Let him do whatever he wants. He's the one that rules the roost.

cards.front: Que hagan lo que quieran. Son los hijos del jefe.
cards.back: Let them do whatever they want. They are the boss's children.

cards.front: Que lo haga otro. Sé que piensas que Pepe es demasiado enigmático.
cards.back: Let somebody else do it. I know that you feel Pepe's too much of a dark horse.

cards.front: Deja que otra persona limpie después de la fiesta. Tú ya has hecho suficiente.
cards.back: Let somebody else clean up after the party. You've already done enough.

cards.front: Deja que otra persona lave los platos. Al final, tú siempre terminas lavándolos.
cards.back: Let someone else do the dishes. You always end up doing them.

cards.front: Que lo haga Pepe si quiere y a ver si así se le quita la expresión de pena de su cara.
cards.back: Let Pepe do it if he wants to do it and if it wipes that hangdog expression off of his face.

cards.front: Que lo escriba Pepe si nadie más quiere hacerlo. Él es muy fiable.
cards.back: Let Pepe write it if nobody else wants to do it. He's a safe pair of hands.

cards.front: Que lo compre Pepe si nadie más puede permitírselo. Yo personalmente creo que es un auténtico robo.
cards.back: Let Pepe buy it if nobody else can afford it. I personally think it's daylight robbery.

cards.front: Que todo el mundo sepa qué está pasando.
cards.back: Let everyone know what's happening.

cards.front: Que todo el mundo sepa en lo que estás trabajando. ¿O es que te da vergüenza?
cards.back: Let everyone know what you're working on. Or are you ashamed?

cards.front: Que el mundo sepa lo que está pasando en este país.
cards.back: Let the world know what's happening in this country.

cards.front: Avísame si necesitas más sándwiches y me pondré con ello en seguida.
cards.back: Let me know if you need any more sandwiches and I'll get cracking.

cards.front: Avísame si hay algo más que pueda hacer por ti, de lo contrario me iré.
cards.back: Let me know if there's anything else I can do for you, otherwise I'll make tracks.

cards.front: Avísame si alguien más puede hacer el relevo; me acabo de enterar de que Janet nos ha abandonado.
cards.back: Let me know if anybody else can take over; I've just found out that Janet's jumped ship.

cards.front: No te dejes embaucar para cargar con más responsabilidad en el trabajo.
cards.back: Don't let them trick you into taking on more responsibility at work.

cards.front: No te dejes embaucar para lavar los platos.
cards.back: Don't let them trick you into washing the dishes.

cards.front: No te dejes embaucar para pagar más de lo que te corresponde.
cards.back: Don't let them trick you into paying more than your fair share.

cards.front: No dejes que te engatusen para quitarte la pensión.
cards.back: Don't let them trick you out of your pension.

cards.front: No dejes que te engatusen para quitarte lo que mereces.
cards.back: Don't let them trick you out of what you're due.

cards.front: No dejes que te engatusen para quitarte tus días de vacaciones.
cards.back: Don't let them trick you out of your days off.

cards.front: No dejes que te mientan.
cards.back: Don't let them lie to you.

cards.front: No dejes que te mientan acerca de los costes ocultos.
cards.back: Don't let them lie to you about hidden costs.

cards.front: No dejes que te mientan acerca de sus verdaderas intenciones.
cards.back: Don't let them lie to you about their true intentions.

cards.front: Eres el mejor escritor que tenemos y no dejes que nadie te diga lo contrario.
cards.back: You're the best writer we have and don't let anyone tell you otherwise.

cards.front: Tienes una nariz sumamente preciosa. No dejes que nadie te diga lo contrario.
cards.back: You have an extremely beautiful nose. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise.

cards.front: Eres más que capaz de aprender una lengua extranjera. No dejes que nadie te diga lo contrario.
cards.back: You're more than capable of learning a foreign language. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise.

cards.front: No dejes que nadie te pisotee.
cards.back: Don't let anyone walk all over you.

cards.front: No dejes que tu jefe te pisotee.
cards.back: Don't let your boss walk all over you.

cards.front: No dejes que personas que apenas conoces te pisoteen.
cards.back: Don't let people you hardly know walk all over you.

cards.front: La contratación de más gente nos permitirá incrementar nuestra producción.
cards.back: The hiring of more people will permit us to increase our production.

cards.front: Podríamos dar una vuelta en coche antes de comer, si tenemos tiempo.
cards.back: We could go for a spin before lunch, time permitting.

cards.front: La empresa no permite a nadie aparcar las motos en la acera.
cards.back: The company doesn't permit anyone to park their motorbikes on the pavement.

cards.front: No soy quién para sancionar ese tipo de medida.
cards.back: I'm not in a position to sanction that type of measure.

cards.front: ¿Cuándo sancionará el gobierno el tratado nuevo?
cards.back: When will the government sanction the new treaty?

cards.front: Dudo que alguien tenga las agallas para sancionar tal cosa.
cards.back: I doubt that anyone will have the guts to sanction such a thing.

cards.front: El genio concedió tres deseos a Aladino.
cards.back: The genie granted Aladdin three wishes.

cards.front: Se me concedió una última oportunidad para demostrar mi valor ante la empresa.
cards.back: I was granted one last chance to prove myself to the rest of the company.

cards.front: Desde luego, no le concedería tanto poder en el proceso de toma de decisiones la próxima vez.
cards.back: I definitely wouldn't grant him so much power in the decision making process next time.

cards.front: No consentiría hacer algo así ni aunque mi vida dependiera de ello.
cards.back: I wouldn't consent to doing something like that even if my life depended on it.

cards.front: Por alguna razón, el paciente no consiente tomar la medicina que le recetamos.
cards.back: For some reason, the patient won't consent to taking the medication we prescribed.

cards.front: ¿Consentirías formar parte de un ensayo médico?
cards.back: Would you consent to taking part in a medical trial?

cards.front: No toleraré ese tipo de comportamiento.
cards.back: I will not stand for that type of behavior.

cards.front: ¿Lo tolerarías si estuvieras en mi lugar?
cards.back: Would you stand for it if you were in my position?

cards.front: No creo que nadie fuera a tolerar algo así.
cards.back: I don't think that anybody would stand for something like that.

cards.front: Él está de muy mal humor hoy. Déjalo en paz.
cards.back: He's in such a bad mood today. Just leave him alone.

cards.front: No sé por qué tratas de cambiar su opinión. Si no quiere ir, déjalo en paz.
cards.back: I don't know why you try to change his mind. If he doesn't want to come, let him be.

cards.front: Déjales en paz: son muy jóvenes.
cards.back: Let them be: they're only young.

cards.front: Ni siquiera queríamos venir, y ni mucho menos quedarnos toda la tarde.
cards.back: We didn't even want to come, let alone stay all evening.

cards.front: Ni siquiera me gusta él, ¿cómo le iba a querer?
cards.back: I don't even like him, let alone love him!

cards.front: Ella no bebe cerveza, y ni mucho menos licores.
cards.back: She doesn't drink beer, let alone spirits.

cards.front: Que se sepa que era un jefe maravilloso.
cards.back: Let it be said that he was a wonderful boss.

cards.front: Que no se diga que no hago nada por ti.
cards.back: Don't let it be said that I never do anything for you.

cards.front: Que no se diga nunca que ella no fue generosa.
cards.back: Never let it be said that she wasn't generous.

cards.front: ¿Suspendiste el examen? Que te sirva de lección para trabajar más en el futuro.
cards.back: You failed the exam?! Let that be a lesson to you to work harder in future.

cards.front: Él no debía de haberte gritado, pero que te sirva de lección para no volverle loco.
cards.back: He shouldn't have yelled at you, but let it be a lesson to you not to wind him up.

cards.front: No me sorprende que estés malo. ¡Que te sirva de lección para no comer tantas golosinas!
cards.back: I'm not surprised you're sick. Let that be a lesson to you not to eat so many sweets!

cards.front: Por favor, permítame presentarle al Dr. Phillips.
cards.back: Please, allow me to introduce you to Dr. Phillips.

cards.front: ¡Permítame!, le dijo mientras abría la puerta para ella.
cards.back: Allow me!, he said, as he opened the door for her.

cards.front: Por favor, permítame el honor de acompañarle al baile.
cards.back: Please allow me the honour of accompanying you to the ball.

cards.front: La tercera parte de la trilogía del Padrino realmente me decepcionó.
cards.back: The third part of The Godfather trilogy really let me down.

cards.front: Ella está matándose intentando agradarle a él porque, pase lo que pase, no quiere decepcionarle.
cards.back: She's killing herself trying to please him because, whatever happens, she doesn't want to let him down.

cards.front: Todos estábamos muy ilusionados con este nuevo gobierno, pero predeciblemente, fuimos decepcionados.
cards.back: We were all very hopeful about this new government, but predictably, we were let down.

cards.front: ¡Cuéntame dónde te haces las uñas! Me encanta tu manicura.
cards.back: Please let me in on where you get your nails done. I love your manicure!

cards.front: ¿Le has contado ya el secreto a Susan?
cards.back: Have you let Susan in on the secret yet?

cards.front: ¡No seas tan enigmático! Cuéntame lo que te ronda la cabeza.
cards.back: Don't be so enigmatic! Let me in on what's on your mind.

cards.front: Ella no dijo nada abiertamente, pero dio a entender que le darían el ascenso pronto.
cards.back: She didn't say anything clearly, but she let on that she would be getting the promotion soon.

cards.front: Él nunca se me declaró, pero me hizo entender que se quería casar conmigo.
cards.back: He never proposed, but he let on that he wanted to marry me.

cards.front: Ella no dio a entender que estuviera muy contenta en la carta.
cards.back: She didn't let on in the letter that she was very happy.

cards.front: Cuando éramos adolescentes, nuestra madre nos pilló robando cervezas del frigo, pero como era Nochevieja, lo dejó pasar con un gesto de la mano.
cards.back: When we were teenagers, our mother caught us stealing beers from the fridge, but as it was New Years' Eve, she let us off with a wave of the hand.

cards.front: ¡Menos mal que a Bernie Madoff no le dejaron escapar sólo con un tirón de orejas!
cards.back: Thank goodness Bernie Madoff wasn't let off with a slap on the wrist!

cards.front: El policía nos echó una mirada severa al dejarnos marchar después de habernos visto cruzar la calle sin estar en un cruce de peatones.
cards.back: The policeman let us off with a stern look after he saw us jaywalking.

cards.front: ¡Qué ganas tengo de que lleguen mis vacaciones! Podré desmelenarme y hacer el vago a todas horas.
cards.back: I can't wait until my vacation! I'll be able to let my hair down and laze around all day.

cards.front: Para Charlie, desmelenarse significa llevar una corbata a rayas en vez de una corbata de color liso.
cards.back: To Charlie, letting his hair down means wearing a striped tie instead of a plain tie.

cards.front: Si de verdad queremos desmelenarnos, deberíamos ir a un karaoke después del trabajo.
cards.back: If we really want to let our hair down, we should go to a karaoke after work.

cards.front: Ella dio un gran suspiro cuando le contamos que estabas sano y salvo.
cards.back: She let out a big sigh of relief when we told her that you were safe and sound.

cards.front: Di un grito enorme cuando marcaron el gol de la victoria.
cards.back: I let out a huge shout when they scored the winning goal.

cards.front: Ella pegó un grito cuando el ladrón intentó robarle la bolsa.
cards.back: She let out a scream when the thief tried to steal her handbag.

cards.front: Ella soltó que está pensando en dimitir.
cards.back: She let out the fact that she was thinking about resigning.

cards.front: Se le escapó sin darse cuenta que su mujer está embarazada.
cards.back: He inadvertently let it out that his wife is pregnant.

cards.front: No descubras el pastel al decirle a ella lo de la fiesta sorpresa.
cards.back: Don't let the cat out of the bag by telling her about the surprise party.

cards.front: Tenemos que salir antes, teniendo en cuenta que puede haber retenciones en algunas carreteras.
cards.back: We need to leave early to allow time for delays on some roads.

cards.front: Deberías tener en cuenta la posibilidad de que no vaya a haber nadie allí a esa hora.
cards.back: You have to allow for the possibility that there won't be anyone there at that time.

cards.front: No te olvides de guardar un poco de dinero para gastos inesperados.
cards.back: Don't forget to allow some money for unexpected costs.

cards.front: No podemos jugar al tenis con este tiempo; tenemos que esperar a que el viento amaine un poco.
cards.back: We can't play tennis in this weather; we have to wait for the wind to let up a little.

cards.front: No pidas que disminuya la cantidad de trabajo; tenemos suerte de tener tanto trabajo en la actual situación económica.
cards.back: Don't ask for the amount of work to let up; we're lucky to have so much work in the present economic climate.

cards.front: Nos marcharemos cuando deje de llover tanto.
cards.back: We'll leave when the rain lets up.

cards.front: Él siempre está hablando; no se calla nunca.
cards.back: He's always talking; he never lets up!

cards.front: Sabes que ella no va a parar hasta que cambies de opinión.
cards.back: You know she won't let up until you change your mind.

cards.front: A pesar de su mala salud él se niega a aflojar el ritmo en el trabajo.
cards.back: In spite of his bad health he refuses to let up at work.
